# uzc_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages a firewall rule on a UzCloud IP address. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the rule. The resource ID is "{ip_address}/{rule_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_firewall_rule" "example" {
  ip_address = uzc_ip_address.example.slug
  protocol   = "tcp"
  cidr_list  = "0.0.0.0/0"
  start_port = 80
  end_port   = 80
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr_list` (String) CIDR block allowed to access the resource (e.g. "0.0.0.0/0").
- `end_port` (Number)
- `ip_address` (String) Slug of the uzc_ip_address to attach the rule to.
- `protocol` (String) One of "tcp", "udp", or "icmp".
- `start_port` (Number)

### Optional

- `destination_cidr_list` (String) Destination CIDR block, if any.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{ip_address}/{rule_id}". Used for import.
- `rule_id` (String) Server-assigned rule id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_firewall_rule.example <ip-address-slug>/<rule-id>
```
